args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail. Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so half-way values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix FIN-212: round_money should use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: `round_money` now uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so half-way values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
